resources.string: Double-press volume up to record, double-press volume down to stop

Lets Pocket Archive notice a quick double-press of the volume keys: double-press volume up starts a voice note, double-press volume down stops it. Single presses always change the volume as usual. Pocket Archive only looks at the volume keys and never reads the screen or what you type. Works while the screen is on and unlocked. Turn it off any time in Pocket Archive → Settings → Recording & shortcuts.
Tap to record a voice note, tap again to save it
